title: Deep learning-based approach to the characterization and quantification of histopathology in mouse models of colitis
summary: Deep-learning histology regions and patch classes separated colitis mouse phenotypes and predicted prospective model/score bins; no human claim follows.
ai_technology: CNN-derived involved/uninvolved histology regions and patch clustering feed downstream mouse-model and clinical-score classifiers.
organization: Department of Biomedical Informatics, Stony Brook University, Stony Brook, NY, United States of America.

evidence.tested: Model outputs distinguished colitis-model histology and predicted mouse model and clinical-score bins in a prospective mouse cohort.
evidence.unknown: Classifier performance was checked against pathologist-labeled patches and on separate prospective mice; evidence is preclinical.
evidence.ai_role: CNN-derived involved/uninvolved histology regions and patch clustering feed downstream mouse-model and clinical-score classifiers.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
